english.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for the person or company responsible for building or improving a structure.

exampleSentences.english: This contractor is responsible for building the new school.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間承建商負責起新校舍。

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a contractor who takes responsibility for construction and hires workers.

exampleSentences.english: This company is the builder for this project.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間公司係今次工程嘅承建商。
